_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: FUSED. Named the OPPONENT under 'target', which the handler does not read, so it fell back to the CONTROLLER. PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM had no 'player' param at all and moves the WHOLE zone, so this emptied the caster's own hand AND arsenal to the bottom of their deck -- for a card that bottoms ONE card of the opponent's.
